seat_fill_rate.basis: statewide ITI admissions / sanctioned seats from DGT tracer study

completion_rate.basis: statewide ITI pass-outs / admissions from DGT tracer study

sector_entry_rate.basis: explicit model prior; sector-specific placement is not verified in available district data

gap_rule: entire 80 percent interval below 1 => gap; entire interval above 1 => surplus; else needs data
assumption_note: Occupation mix and course-to-NCO crosswalk are analyst priors for the worked illustration. Replace with PLFS microdata and district MIS/DSDP as they become available.
